<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The simple promo (model promo@1): one offer with the discount as a badge, the heading, the deadline as text
  (no countdown), a description, an optional promo code, one action and a picture. Axes: media (end: the picture
  after the copy from md up, start: before it, top: above it, wide).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

  export type PromoSimpleProps = {
    id: string;
    badge?: string;
    title: string;
    deadline: string;
    description?: string;
    code?: string;
    actionLabel?: string;
    actionHref?: string;
    image?: string;
    imageAlt: string;
    imageSrcset?: string;
    level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
    padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
    align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
    media?: "end" | "start" | "top";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../compose/Badge.svelte";
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Container from "../compose/Container.svelte";
  import LinkButton from "../compose/LinkButton.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    badge = "",
    title,
    deadline,
    description = "",
    code = "",
    actionLabel = "",
    actionHref = "",
    image = "",
    imageAlt,
    imageSrcset = "",
    level = 2,
    padding = "standard",
    align = "start",
    media = "end",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: PromoSimpleProps = $props();
  const titleId = $derived(id + "-title");
  const column = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
    : "start"
  );
  const textAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
    : "text-start"
  );
  const itemsAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
    : "items-start"
  );
  const selfAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
    : ""
  );
  const frame = $derived(
    (media as string) === "top" ? "flex flex-col gap-8"
    : "grid grid-cols-1 items-center gap-12 md:grid-cols-2"
  );
  const pictureCell = $derived(((media as string) === "end") ? "w-full" : "order-first w-full");
  const ratio = $derived(((media as string) === "top") ? "21/9" : "4/3");
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  class={
    (padding as string) === "compact" ? "py-8 lg:py-16"
    : (padding as string) === "spacious" ? "py-24 lg:py-40"
    : "py-16 lg:py-32"
  }
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)}
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
  data-slot="promo-simple"
>
  <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
    <Box class={frame}>
      <Stack gap="4" align={column}>
        {#if badge}
          <Badge variant="default">
            {badge}
          </Badge>
        {/if}
        <Title as={level} size="4xl" weight="bold" class={cn("max-w-2xl tracking-tight", textAlign)} id={titleId}>
          {title}
        </Title>
        <Text size="base" weight="semibold" class={cn("text-primary", textAlign)}>
          {deadline}
        </Text>
        {#if description}
          <Text size="lg" class={cn("text-muted-foreground", textAlign)}>
            {description}
          </Text>
        {/if}
        {#if code}
          <Text size="sm" class={cn("rounded border border-border px-4 py-2", textAlign)}>
            {code}
          </Text>
        {/if}
        {#if (actionLabel && actionHref)}
          <LinkButton variant="default" size="lg" href={urlOf(actionHref)}>
            {actionLabel}
          </LinkButton>
        {/if}
      </Stack>
      <Box class={pictureCell}>
        <MediaFrame alt={imageAlt} src={image} srcset={imageSrcset} ratio={ratio} class="rounded" />
      </Box>
    </Box>
  </Container>
</Block>
